Message.Name: Login Accepted Message
Message.Description: Sent to indicate a successful login. Carries the current version of ArcaTrade.

Field.Name: Version ID
Field.Description: Version of the ArcaTrade protocol, formatted vv.vv.

Field.Name: Padding
Field.Description: Not used.

Message.Name: Login Rejected Message
Message.Description: Sent when login fails authentication, the client does not log in within 30 seconds, no trade data feed was subscribed to, the sequence number was invalid, or no connections are available. The socket is closed afterwards.

Field.Name: Reject Code
Field.Description: The reason the login was rejected.

Field.Name: Padding
Field.Description: Not used.

Message.Name: Heartbeat Message
Message.Description: Sent every 60 seconds during periods of client inactivity, so that firewalls do not time the connection out. The client must answer with a Heartbeat Response. There is no message body, and the header length is always zero.

Message.Name: Test Response Message
Message.Description: Sent in response to a Test Request, echoing back any text the request carried.

Field.Name: Test Message
Field.Description: Text sent in the Test Request message.

Message.Name: Last Sale Message
Message.Description: Sent when an order partially trades or completely trades.

Field.Name: Last Sale Time
Field.Description: Time the trade occurred, in milliseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Sequence Number
Field.Description: Message sequence number, 1 to 2147483647.

Field.Name: Trade Reference Number
Field.Description: The unique reference number per trading platform (system code) assigned to this trade.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Number of bonds traded.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Trade price. Divide by the denominator the Price Scale Code names.

Field.Name: Price Scale Code
Field.Description: The power of ten dividing the price fields in this message.

Field.Name: System Code
Field.Description: The trading platform that produced this trade.

Field.Name: Exchange Code
Field.Description: Whether this is a Nyse listed bond.

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Field.Name: Security Type
Field.Description: The type of bond. Additional types will be supported in future releases.

Field.Name: NYSE Bond Symbol
Field.Description: A Nyse Arca specific identity for this bond.

Field.Name: CUSIP / ISIN
Field.Description: Cusip or Isin for the bond. Null unless the client requested the data and holds a licence.

Field.Name: Padding
Field.Description: Not used.

Message.Name: Trade Bust or Correction Message
Message.Description: Sent when trades are busted or corrected. The Event Code field says which.

Field.Name: Last Sale Time
Field.Description: Time the trade occurred, in milliseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Sequence Number
Field.Description: Message sequence number, 1 to 2147483647.

Field.Name: Trade Reference Number
Field.Description: The unique reference number per trading platform (system code) assigned to the trade that has been busted or modified.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Number of bonds busted or corrected.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Busted or corrected trade price.

Field.Name: Price Scale Code
Field.Description: The power of ten dividing the price fields in this message.

Field.Name: System Code
Field.Description: The trading platform that produced this trade.

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: Whether the trade was busted or corrected.

Field.Name: Exchange Code
Field.Description: Whether this is a Nyse listed bond.

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Field.Name: Security Type
Field.Description: The type of bond. Additional types will be supported in future releases.

Field.Name: NYSE Bond Symbol
Field.Description: A Nyse Arca specific identity for this bond.

Field.Name: CUSIP / ISIN
Field.Description: Cusip or Isin for the bond. Null unless the client requested the data and holds a licence.

Field.Name: Padding
Field.Description: Not used.

Message.Name: NYSE Bond Closing Price Message
Message.Description: Sent during day end processing with the final closing price and volume for a bond. The specification notes this message is not supported at the time of writing and will be implemented in a future release.

Field.Name: Closing Time
Field.Description: Time the closing price was set, in milliseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Sequence Number
Field.Description: Message sequence number, 1 to 2147483647.

Field.Name: Trade Reference Number
Field.Description: The unique reference number per trading platform (system code) assigned to the closing price.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Number of bonds for the closing price.

Field.Name: Closing Price
Field.Description: The closing price.

Field.Name: Price Scale Code
Field.Description: The power of ten dividing the price fields in this message.

Field.Name: System Code
Field.Description: The trading platform that produced this closing price.

Field.Name: Exchange Code
Field.Description: Whether this is a Nyse listed bond.

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Field.Name: Security Type
Field.Description: The type of bond. Additional types will be supported in future releases.

Field.Name: NYSE Bond Symbol
Field.Description: A Nyse Arca specific identity for this bond.

Field.Name: CUSIP / ISIN
Field.Description: Cusip or Isin for the bond. Null unless the client requested the data and holds a licence.

Field.Name: Padding
Field.Description: Not used.
